messages.author: jordan@harborview.io
messages.text: Welcome Omar! Figured this beats email for the sandbox work. Sam from our solutions team is in here too.

messages.author: odiaz@globex.com
messages.text: nice, this works. what do you need from us to get the sandbox loaded?

messages.author: sam@harborview.io
messages.text: A schema export from your order system and read creds for a staging copy of the warehouse db. Template for both incoming.

messages.author: odiaz@globex.com
messages.text: schema export sent to your secure upload. staging creds coming after our infra guy rotates them

messages.author: sam@harborview.io
messages.text: Got the export, schemas look clean. One question: the order_status enum has 14 values, do all of them actually occur?

messages.author: odiaz@globex.com
messages.text: lol no, maybe 8 in practice. the rest are from an old migration. welcome to globex

messages.author: sam@harborview.io
messages.text: Sandbox is loading. Should have your real flows running by early next week.

messages.author: odiaz@globex.com
messages.text: sandbox is up and running on our side, looks great so far. btw Rhea K. still waiting on that ROI doc - she asked me about it this morning

messages.author: jordan@harborview.io
messages.text: On it - the seasonality modeling took longer than planned, sent her a first-look one-pager in the meantime

messages.author: odiaz@globex.com
messages.text: ran the exception flow against last month's data. caught 3 mismatches our manual process missed. showed my team, they're sold

messages.author: sam@harborview.io
messages.text: Love to hear it. Those 3 would've been silent failures in most setups.

messages.author: odiaz@globex.com
messages.text: can you send over your SSO docs? want to have them ready for the eng review

messages.author: sam@harborview.io
messages.text: Sent - SAML + OIDC guides plus the SCIM provisioning doc.

messages.author: odiaz@globex.com
messages.text: pushing internally to get a decision this month. priya wants a technical review with her team first - trying to get it scheduled for next week

messages.author: jordan@harborview.io
messages.text: We can do any day next week. Sam will run it. Anything specific her team will want beyond SSO?

messages.author: odiaz@globex.com
messages.text: data residency and the API rate limits probably. she's thorough, come prepared
